energy_credit.name: Energy Cell
energy_credit.shortDescription: A basic power source that is compatible with most machines. Rechargeable.
energy_credit.flavorText: In an effort to reduce waste, single-use batteries were made illegal by the Republic.

energy_credit_breeder.name: Self Charging Energy Cell
energy_credit_breeder.shortDescription: An advanced and rare energy cell capable of self charging

energy_credit_ext.name: Energy Cell (Mk. II)
energy_credit_ext.shortDescription: An improved power source that is compatible with most machines. Rechargeable.
energy_credit_ext.flavorText: Improving on the standard model, the Mk. II cell is bigger, better and even more of a choking hazard.

energy_credit_dis.name: Disposable Battery
energy_credit_dis.shortDescription: A high capacity single-use energy cell. Cannot be recharged.
energy_credit_dis.flavorText: Favored in the Upper Levels for its convenience.

current_converter.name: Current Converter
current_converter.shortDescription: Draw power directly from the Lower Levels' grid to power any machine instead of a battery. The Current Converter nightly service must be paid in order to receive power.

energy_credit_hyp.name: Hypertech Power Cell
energy_credit_hyp.shortDescription: An experimental cell with no stored charge. It powers any machine whose draw stays within the cell's output rating, indefinitely. Machines that draw more than the rating get nothing.

intel_sec.name: Security Record
intel_sec.shortDescription: Your contact will keep this up to date
intel_sec.flavorText: A copy of your security record file from the Security Department

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.shortDescription: A heavy duty flashlight. While carrying this, you are less likely to be injured while scavenging in the Dumping Grounds.

tutorial_book.name: Mentor's Handbook
tutorial_book.shortDescription: A book for keeping track of all notes givien to you by The Mentor. Handy!

cigarette_guide.name: Hemingway Identification Guide
cigarette_guide.shortDescription: A guide that helps identify counterfeit Hemingway Cigarettes.

hand_guide.name: Cybernetic Hand Appraisal Guide
hand_guide.shortDescription: A guide for determining the appropriate value of cybernetic hands.

fuel_guide.name: Plasma Cartridge Appraisal Guide
fuel_guide.shortDescription: A guide for determining the appropriate value of Plasma Cartridges.

ribwich_guide.name: Ribwich Appraisal Guide
ribwich_guide.shortDescription: A handy guide that helps with determining the correct value of a Ribwich.

stamp_guide.name: Food Stamp Identification Handbook
stamp_guide.shortDescription: A handy guide to identifying a genuine Food Stamp from a counterfeit.

injector_guide.name: Immunivax Assessment Guide
injector_guide.shortDescription: Contains all the information you need to reliably assess the condition of Immunivax Injectors.

water_guide.name: Water Trading Manual
water_guide.shortDescription: A handy manual that contains all the information on buying and selling Water.

hydroponic_guide.name: Hydroponic Farming Manual
hydroponic_guide.shortDescription: A handy manual that contains all the information on hydroponic farming.

chemistry_guide.name: Chemistry Manual
chemistry_guide.shortDescription: A handy manual that contains the basics of chemistry.

lou_old_orders.name: Old Republic Orders
lou_old_orders.shortDescription: A yellowed, brittle sheet. It looks like it has been folded and unfolded many times. It's a written order addressed to Lou, dated years ago. A faded Republic seal is still visible at the top.
lou_old_orders.flavorText:
REPUBLIC JOINT SPECIAL OPERATIONS COMMAND, PRIORITY ORDER
TO: Emergency Response Team Leader Lou

Stop stalling for time and carry out this order immediately. Take your team and start the self-destruct sequence of the research ship Icarus. Disable all the escape pods and do not allow any survivor from the Icarus to escape with your team. Do it, or I will have you court-martialed.

(The signature has faded beyond reading.)

logo_checker.name: Republic Logo Checker
logo_checker.shortDescription: A reference for the Official Republic Logo.

mentor_contract.name: Lease Agreement
mentor_contract.shortDescription: Your lease. Signed by you, and your Landlord.

business_permit.name: Business Permit
business_permit.shortDescription: A permit issued by the Republic. Required to legally operate a business in the Lower Levels.

handnote.name: Handnote
handnote.shortDescription: A simple note, written by hand.

scav_token.name: Scavenger's Token
scav_token.shortDescription: A token given by the Scavenger community. Each token placed in the display case will increase the chance of a Scavenger visit.

black_lamp.name: Black Lamp
black_lamp.shortDescription: When placed in the display case, it signals thieves that this shop fences stolen goods. Your Black Market reputation affects how likely they are to respond.

dossier.name: Dossier
dossier.shortDescription: Can hold documents, notes, books and magnifying glasses.

trashcan.name: Trash Can
trashcan.shortDescription: Items inside will be permanently removed at night if Janitorial Service is paid.

drain.name: Water Drain
drain.shortDescription: Unwanted water can be dump here

faucet.name: Water Faucet
faucet.shortDescription: No water... Maybe someone can help connect it to a water line?

cmd_keycard.name: Disposable Keycard (Command)
cmd_keycard.shortDescription: A single-use keycard for Station Command. Can open most locks that require keycard access.
cmd_keycard.flavorText: A master keycard, to be carried only by Station Command.

sec_keycard.name: Disposable Keycard (Security)
sec_keycard.shortDescription: A single-use keycard for Station Security. Can open locks that require Security Department access.
sec_keycard.flavorText: Could be dangerous if this falls into the wrong hands...

sci_keycard.name: Disposable Keycard (Research)
sci_keycard.shortDescription: A single-use keycard for Research and Development. Can open locks that require Science Department access.
sci_keycard.flavorText: Keycard carried by the Station's Research Officers. Valuable.

med_keycard.name: Disposable Keycard (Medical)
med_keycard.flavorText: A single-use keycard for the Station's Medical Department. Can open locks that require Medical access.

eng_keycard.name: Disposable Keycard (Engineering)
eng_keycard.flavorText: A single-use keycard for the Station's Engineering Department. Can open locks that require Engineer access.

sup_keycard.name: Disposable Keycard (Supply)
sup_keycard.flavorText: A single-use keycard for the Station's Supply Department. Can open locks that require Supply access.

ser_keycard.name: Disposable Keycard (Service)
ser_keycard.flavorText: A single-use keycard for the Station's Service Department. Can open locks that require Service access.

blank_keycard.name: Disposable Keycard (Blank)
blank_keycard.shortDescription: An unwritten keycard. With the right machine, this can be reprogrammed with all kinds of access.
blank_keycard.flavorText: As close to a skeleton key as you'll find on the Station.

card_mining.name: Business Card (GP Mining Coop)
card_mining.flavorText: No one really know what GP stands for anymore.

card_pharma.name: Business Card (Pharmacist)
card_pharma.flavorText: A very plain card with only a name and a phone number.

card_chem.name: Business Card (Chemist)
card_chem.flavorText: It really is just a piece a paper with a phone number on it.

card_rev.name: Business Card (Green)
card_rev.flavorText: A simple green business card with a phone number on it.

permit_gun_1.name: Class I Weapon Permit
permit_gun_1.shortDescription: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 0.
permit_gun_1.flavorText: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade low level contraband firearms and ammunition.

permit_gun_2.name: Class II Weapon Permit
permit_gun_2.shortDescription: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 30.
permit_gun_2.flavorText: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade mid level contraband weapons.

permit_gun_3.name: Class III Weapon Permit
permit_gun_3.shortDescription: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 60.
permit_gun_3.flavorText: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade high level contraband weapons.

canister_mbs.name: MBS Nerve Gas
canister_mbs.shortDescription: A highly toxic chemical weapon designed to disrupt the nervous system. Symptoms include: Respiratory failure, Convulsions, Loss of bodily functions, Unconsciousness and Death.

sec_slip.name: Incident Slip
sec_slip.shortDescription: A slip given by the Security Department after responding to an incident.

rev_codeword.name: Codeword List
rev_codeword.shortDescription: An inconspicuous slip of paper with a hastily written key for the code used by revolutionaries.

food_stamp.name: Food Stamp (40 Credits)
food_stamp.shortDescription: Redeem it at the Commissary to buy Food.
food_stamp.flavorText: A prepaid card valid only to buy groceries. Part of a benefit program to assist the less fortunate in the Lower Levels.

debris_pile1.name: Pile of Debris
debris_pile1.shortDescription: You will spend some time clearing the debris whenever you sleep without going out of the Store.

debris_pile2.name: Pile of Debris
debris_pile2.shortDescription: You will need tools to clear this one. Each tool used on it will be destroyed.

debris_pile3.name: Pile of Debris
debris_pile3.shortDescription: Far too heavy to move yourself. The Debris Removal nightly service will be needed to clear it.

hand.name: Cybernetic Hand
hand.flavorText: A marvel of biomechanical engineering, designed to mirror the form and function of the hand it replaces.

cert1.name: Appraisal Board Junior Certificate
cert1.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customers needing appraisal service to visit.
cert1.flavorText: Certifies you as a junior appraiser.

cert2.name: Appraisal Board Certificate
cert2.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customers needing appraisal service to visit.
cert2.flavorText: Certifies your rank on the Appraiser Board.

cert3.name: Appraisal Board Senior Certificate
cert3.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customers needing appraisal service to visit.
cert3.flavorText: Certifies your rank on the Appraiser Board.

cert4.name: Appraisal Board Master Certificate
cert4.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customers needing appraisal service to visit.
cert4.flavorText: Certifies your rank on the Appraiser Board.

cassette8.name: Music Cassette - A Bao A Qu (Pristine)

cassette8l.name: Music Cassette - A Bao A Qu (Damaged)

cassette8d.name: Music Cassette - A Bao A Qu (Corrupted)

ribwich.name: Packaged Rib Sandwich
ribwich.shortDescription: A shelf stable limited edition sandwich consists of a restructured boneless pork patty shaped like a miniature rack of ribs. It has a cult following.

scratcher.name: Scratcher Ticket
scratcher.shortDescription: Scratch off at least 2 matching symbols to win a prize!
scratcher.flavorText: A popular form of gambling in the Lower Levels. It is banned in the Upper Levels.

gamblers_coin.name: Gambler's Coin
gamblers_coin.flavorText: A coin from a currency nobody remembers. They say it brings luck. Mostly, it scratches tickets faster.

scratcher_stack.name: Stack of Scratcher Tickets (5)
scratcher_stack.shortDescription: Make sure to have enough space before unpacking it.
scratcher_stack.flavorText: A stack of five lottery scratch cards.

plasma_fuel.name: Plasma Cartridge
plasma_fuel.shortDescription: A compact, solid-state fuel cartridge used in Pulse Plasma Drives for space travel. Value varies wildly depending on the quality of the cartridge.

aug_scanner.name: Aug Scanner
aug_scanner.shortDescription: Used to confirm the presence of a suspected Aug with 100% accuracy.
aug_scanner.flavorText: An energy hungry electromagnetic field detector fine tuned to pick up on the unique signatures of the Augmentation chip.
